name: NIKE, Inc.
summary:
NIKE (NKE) reported earnings of $0.48 per share on revenue of $11.21 billion for the fiscal first quarter ended August 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.43 per share on revenue of $11.40 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $0.48 per share. The company reported in-line with expectations while revenue fell 4.33% compared to the same quarter a year ago.

The company said it expects fiscal 2027 earnings of $1.15 to $1.35 per share on revenue of approximately $42.92 billion. The current consensus earnings estimate is $1.61 per share on revenue of $45.62 billion for the year ending May 31, 2027.

"The Sport Offense is driving measurable progress across our performance business, and we introduced Pace to help us accelerate and scale that momentum across NIKE," said Elliott Hill, President and Chief Executive Officer, NIKE, Inc. "We have more work to do in NIKE Sportswear, Jordan Brand and Greater China, and we're taking deliberate actions to strengthen those businesses the right way for the long-term."

NIKE, Inc. is the world's leading designer, marketer and distributor of authentic athletic footwear, apparel, equipment and accessories for a wide variety of sports and fitness activities.
subject: NIKE Reported In-line with Expectations, Guides Below Estimates

name: Accenture plc
summary:
Accenture plc (ACN) reported earnings of $3.29 per share on revenue of $18.68 billion for the fiscal fourth quarter ended August 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $3.19 per share on revenue of $18.01 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $3.27 per share. The company beat expectations by 0.61% while revenue grew 6.15% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it expects fiscal 2027 earnings of $14.39 to $14.81 per share on revenue of $76.43 billion to $78.65 billion. The current consensus earnings estimate is $14.63 per share on revenue of $76.45 billion for the year ending August 31, 2027.

“We exceeded our fourth-quarter revenue guidance range and capped off another year of broad-based growth across our business, grew adjusted EPS 8%, returned a record $11.5 billion to shareholders and reached a new high of 141 quarterly client bookings of $100 million or more. These results reflect the continued trust our clients place in us to help them reinvent and create value, the high level of innovation we bring every day and the extraordinary commitment of our Reinventors to our clients’ success.”

Accenture PLC is a professional service company. The Company is engaged in providing management consulting, technology and outsourcing services to clients.
subject: Accenture plc Beat Expectations, Guides In-line

name: McCormick & Company, Incorporated
summary:
McCormick & Company, (MKC) reported earnings of $0.86 per share on revenue of $2.02 billion for the fiscal third quarter ended August 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.75 per share on revenue of $1.98 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $0.75 per share. The company beat expectations by 14.67% while revenue grew 17.39% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it continues to expect fiscal 2026 earnings of $3.05 to $3.13 per share on revenue of $7.73 billion to $8.00 billion. The current consensus earnings estimate is $3.08 per share on revenue of $7.85 billion for the year ending November 30, 2026.

McCormick & Company Inc manufactures, markets and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavorful products to the entire food industryretail outlets, food manufacturers and foodservice businesses.
subject: McCormick & Company, Beat Expectations, Reaffirms

name: Acuity Inc.
summary:
Acuity (AYI) reported earnings of $5.77 per share on revenue of $1.24 billion for the fiscal fourth quarter ended August 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $5.61 per share on revenue of $1.26 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $5.80 per share. The company missed expectations by 0.52% while revenue grew 2.92% on a year-over-year basis.

Acuity Brands Inc is engaged in designing, producing and distributing lighting solutions, components, and services for commercial, institutional, industrial, infrastructure, and residential applications throughout North America and international markets.
subject: Acuity Missed Expectations
